children: Hong Kong's first five-year plan marks a turning point in the city's economic landscape, says Marcos Chan, head of research at CBRE Hong Kong in a note. The plan includes nearly double the spending on technology and innovation. Chan says the city is diversifying its economy and paving the way for sustainable growth. Hong Kong needs a balanced model to support traditional industries and emerging tech sectors, he notes. This plan is also asking "business stakeholders to rethink their approach to future growth and re-formulate their business strategies," he says. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
